claim.metric: Average Success Rate (ASR, %) for first-order stable systems, fast mode, ControlAgent with GPT-4-turbo

notes: Iterative design loop: the LLM proposes controller parameters, a Python agent computes settling time and phase margin and feeds back; re-execution needs a re-implemented evaluator (control library), heavier than a plain prompt run. 'gpt-4-turbo' alias used in Oct 2024 (GA).

resolution.plan: The 50 first-order stable fast-mode systems (transfer functions with settling-time and phase-margin targets) are hand-curated (Sec. 5) and exist only in the repository's ControlEval. Run the Appendix E.1 central-agent / task-specific-agent loop with gpt-4-turbo at temperature 0 and max_tokens 1024, re-implementing the Python evaluator with python-control (loop-shaping gains, phase margin, settling time) as sketched in Figure 2, and compute ASR = share of systems meeting all requirements within the iteration budget; compare with 94.0 (Table 4).
resolution.approximation: The iteration cap and the evaluator's settling-time definition are taken from the repository; results vary between runs despite temperature 0.
